vectors.name: coproc-served-psoc
vectors.note: the CDC set: every reply but the pong from 1 to the coprocessor

steps.note: a ping from a reply slot: the pong to that slot
an info request with a slot source: the reply to the coprocessor
S-10c.061: the option off, so 04 here too
pong, log configuration and unknown ids: no reply

vectors.name: coproc-firmware-psoc
vectors.note: the firmware command as on CDC (forced, S-10c.075)

steps.note: a product word that fails: 84 PRODUCT

vectors.name: coproc-unlock-psoc
vectors.note: S-10c.061 holds on this link: with the option on, the unlock and set metadata act as on CDC

vectors.name: coproc-early-psoc
vectors.note: before held mode (S-07.023 steps 1-6a): no transfer starts, no reboot runs

steps.note: a product word that passes: 84, the transfer cannot start
a product word that fails: 84 PRODUCT, as in held mode
a reboot with mode 2: no effect
a reboot to the OS: no effect
the pong: no reboot ran, so the link is still served

vectors.name: coproc-early-continue-psoc
vectors.note: continue to the OS before held mode (S-10c.045, S-10c.076): 84, no effect

steps.note: the pong: no restart ran, so the link is still served

vectors.name: coproc-held-psoc
vectors.note: the same reboot in held mode: it runs

steps.note: a ping: the next frame is its pong, so nothing came in between
a reboot with mode 2: reason 10 (S-04.021), no reply
